import json
import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('/tmp/tp-glm53-mfma')
s = Path('/tmp/tp-glm53-gemv-width/baseline-disasm.json').read_text()
program = json.loads(s[s.index('{\n'):])['programs'][-1]
shapes = []
names = {}
for d in program['insts']:
    if d['op_name'] != 'Gemv':
        continue
    tensors = {t['name']: t.get('tensor') for t in d['tensors']}
    if 'layers.77.' not in (tensors.get('W') or ''):
        continue
    m, n, k = d['raw']['i'][:3]
    for name in (tensors['W'], tensors['x']):
        names.setdefault(name, f'tensor{len(names):02d}')
    shapes.append(dict(m=m, n=n, k=k, groups=d['blocks'],
                       weight=tensors['W'], activation=tensors['x'],
                       weight_file=names[tensors['W']] + '.b001.bin',
                       activation_file=names[tensors['x']] + '.b001.bin'))
(root / 'shapes.json').write_text(json.dumps(shapes, indent=2) + '\n')
(root / 'tensor-names.json').write_text(json.dumps(names, indent=2) + '\n')
os.environ.update(PLOW_DUMP_ACT=','.join(f'{name}:{root / file}' for name, file in names.items()),
                  PLOW_MLA_PF_V2='1', PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER='1', PLOW_PF_CHUNK='8192',
                  PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE='0')
prompts = [','.join([str(i + 1)] * length) for i, length in enumerate([512] * 7 + [32768])]
cmd = ['/tmp/tp-glm53-merge-review/plowrt', 'amd-bench', '--blob',
       '/tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/assets/model.pkt', '--hsaco',
       '/tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/objects', '--checkpoint',
       '/workspace/models/GLM-5.3-plow-lite', '--prompt', ';'.join(prompts),
       '--batched', '--tp', '8', '--steps', '2']
with (root / 'capture.log').open('w') as log:
    subprocess.run(cmd, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=True)
recipes.campaign.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
root=/tmp/tp-glm53-mfma
if [ "$#" = 0 ]; then set -- control selected; fi
for arm in "$@"; do
    export PLOW_HSACO="$root/overlay-$arm"
    /tmp/tp-glm53-merge-review/plowrt serve --assets /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/assets --port 18976 > "$root/server-$arm.log" 2>&1 &
    server=$!
    trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
    ready=0
    for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
        if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18976/v1/models > "$root/models-$arm.json" 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
        kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
        sleep 1
    done
    [ "$ready" = 1 ]
    python3 runtime/bench/amd/mla_sparse_aiter/quality.py http://127.0.0.1:18976 "gemv-mfma-$arm" "$root/quality-$arm.json" --concurrency 8 > "$root/quality-$arm.log" 2>&1
    env VLLM_ROCM_LIB=/opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib /app/plow/build-gemma31/vllm-python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve --backend vllm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18976 --model glm-5.3-plow-lite --tokenizer zai-org/GLM-5.3 --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random --num-prompts 20 --random-input-len 70000 --random-output-len 700 --random-range-ratio 0.14 --max-concurrency 20 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir "$root" --result-filename "serve-$arm.json" > "$root/bench-$arm.log" 2>&1
    kill -TERM "$server"
    wait "$server" || [ "$?" = 143 ]
    trap - EXIT
done
